messages.subject: Packet B succeeded: transactional shared memory, 129 tests green
messages.body: Implemented idempotent source-separated import, atomic durable command receipts, contribution/review services and Node HTTP subrouter in implementation commit 8cc10fd372b861cbf297cb584207547f8b509019, with report delivery commit 12955b51ee1f5d4cf0bfaf66ca6c75df471c8f77. All 129 server tests pass and server typecheck is clean after one focused test-typing repair, including concurrent contradictory reviews, durable restart retries and immutable real-record sources. Coordinator wiring of createCommonsService and commonsRoutes plus integrated UI verification remains, with exact signatures, changed paths, origins, commands and observed Codex harness limitations documented in evidence/orca/B-report.md.
